whyItMatters: eval evaluates strings as perl code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace eval with a dispatch table for dynamic behavior so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no eval call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no eval reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
